categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Chipscreen Biosciences Co., Ltd. focuses on innovative drug research and development, production, and commercialization. Its primary business segments include oncology drugs, metabolic disease drugs, and early-stage drug discovery in areas such as autoimmune and central nervous system diseases. The company has developed and commercialized original small molecule drugs and maintains a pipeline covering clinical and preclinical stages.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs an integrated drug discovery platform based on AI-assisted design and chemical genomics technology for early-stage drug discovery and evaluation. It uses Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards for production, with two main production bases in Shenzhen and Chengdu. The production process includes strict quality control and internal supervision to ensure product quality and compliance with regulatory standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, pharmacies, and medical institutions across China, with major sales concentrated in South China, East China, and North China regions. The company serves patients with cancer, type 2 diabetes, and other metabolic and autoimmune diseases. Its products are also marketed internationally, including in Japan, Taiwan, and the United States.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant market coverage in 27 provinces and over 1300 hospitals nationwide. It also has commercial presence in Japan, Taiwan, and the United States, with ongoing clinical trials and regulatory activities in these regions. The company’s subsidiaries are located in Shenzhen and Chengdu, and it has a wholly owned subsidiary in the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chipscreen operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug discovery, clinical development, manufacturing, and commercialization. It owns production facilities and manages distribution through a network of distributors and direct sales teams, ensuring product delivery to hospitals and pharmacies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on original small molecule drugs with novel mechanisms of action. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 77.3% ratio of R&D expenditure to revenue in 2023. Key R&D areas include oncology, metabolic diseases, autoimmune diseases, central nervous system disorders, and antiviral therapies. The company also pursues international clinical trials and regulatory approvals to expand global market access.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of proprietary drugs such as Epidaza (chidamide) and Dualoglin (saroglitazar), licensing fees, and technology transfer agreements. The company also earns income from milestone payments related to licensing deals and provides contract research and development services. Sales are conducted via a combination of direct sales teams and authorized distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chipscreen is positioned as a leading innovative drug developer in China’s biopharmaceutical sector, particularly in small molecule oncology and metabolic drugs. It competes with both domestic and international pharmaceutical companies in the innovative drug market. The company emphasizes first-in-class and best-in-class drug development to differentiate itself amid increasing competition and market saturation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 523.7 million, a slight decrease of 1.18% from the previous year, mainly due to reduced milestone income. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 88.8 million, a significant increase driven by changes in consolidation scope and investment gains. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.2 billion, with a steady growth trajectory supported by increased R&D investment and expanding commercialization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chipscreen offers innovative, original small molecule drugs with novel mechanisms that address unmet clinical needs, such as the first selective HDAC inhibitor for peripheral T-cell lymphoma and the first global PPAR pan-agonist for type 2 diabetes. Its integrated AI-driven drug discovery platform enhances success rates and reduces development risks. The company’s products provide differentiated therapeutic benefits, supported by robust clinical data and inclusion in national reimbursement lists, enhancing patient access and market competitiveness.
